cards.t: Strategy Faces Index Removal Under Finalized MSCI Rules
cards.b: MSCI finalized rules to classify non-operating companies as ineligible starting November 30, targeting firms like Strategy whose balance sheets are dominated by a single asset.

per.BTC: Potential index removal of major corporate holder Strategy could impact market sentiment and treasury-driven demand.
